title: Grateful Dead Live at Indianapolis Sports and Music Center on 1984-06-30
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) ->KORG AudioGate 4 -> Adobe Audition CC 2015 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 -> Oade M118 -> Cassette Master (Sony WM-D6C/Dennon DXM-90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent capture of a magical 6/30‑84 show, highlighted by the Lost Sailor > Saint of Circumstance > Deal sequence and a rare Bob lead on Spoonful.
ai_review.review: The reviewer describes this 6/30‑84 performance as an “amazing” night that still radiates its special "IT" factor when listened to, noting standout moments like the pre‑drums Shakedown Street → Playing in the Band → Terrapin Station stretch and a rare Bobby Weir solo on Spoonful. The audio transfer is praised for preserving that magic, with no reported flaws, making it both a superb musical and listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: One highly detailed 5‑star review praises the show’s performance and indicates the recording faithfully captures the magic, leading to a high combined rating despite limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints; reviewer says the 'magic' transfers well onto tape, implying clear and engaging sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The setlist is described as "cool" with a special pre‑drums sequence and rare moments, giving the concert a flowing, magical feel.

band_member_comments.Bob: Rare lead guitar solo on Spoonful noted by reviewer
